debrief db-021
1) the actor c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d the collusive bidding scheme to rig the public tender, left behind the case exhibit as an evidence record, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the a-n-t-i-t-r-u-s-t review check.
2) the actor s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d the cover bids for the competitors, deposited the b-i-d-d-i-n-g documentation in the tender file, and b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-e verification step.
3) the actor s-h-a-r-e-d the p-r-i-c-i-n-g data among the participants, stored the c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n logs in the exercise archive, and n-e-g-l-e-c-t-e-d the d-a-t-a p-r-o-t-e-c-t-i-o-n compliance check.
4) the actor i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d the r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n schedule for the winning bids, kept the s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e records as exercise artifacts, and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t audit trail check.
5) the actor m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n-e-d the appearance of competition in the procurement process, filed the r-e-p-o-r-t in the closed matter database, and a-v-o-i-d-e-d the f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n screening check.
